title: Listen to understand

character.description: two fictional friends in their twenties: a young woman with long curly red hair and freckles in a denim jacket, and a young woman with straight black hair in a white sweater

shots.still: in a cozy cafe, the woman with curly red hair is talking with feeling while the woman with black hair looks down at her phone, half listening, warm cafe light
shots.motion: The red-haired woman talks expressively while her friend keeps scrolling her phone and nods absently

shots.still: in the cozy cafe, the two friends sit on opposite sides of a small round table facing each other: the woman with curly red hair wearing her denim jacket is talking, and the woman with straight black hair wearing her white sweater has put her phone face down on the table and listens with calm full attention, warm cafe light
shots.motion: Both stay seated on opposite sides of the table; the black-haired woman listens attentively and nods slowly while her friend talks with small hand gestures

shots.still: in the cozy cafe, both friends laughing together across the small table, coffee cups, warm golden light, genuine joy
shots.motion: Both friends laugh together warmly, one covers her mouth while laughing

texts.text: Most people don't listen to understand.
Be the one who actually hears them.
